text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: high GPU pool pressure detected for cluster 'us-west-2'. auto-escalation to on-call (carla-oncall) at 2024-04-08T14:13:09Z
carla-oncall: I'm on it, joining. initial alert shows sustained queue growth on ml-infer-queue and HPA not triggering additional replicas.
alice-sre: seeing 95% utilization on infer-gpu-prod, PodPending spikes due to node autoscaler throttle. HPA events show metric 'custom/gpu_queue_length' not updating for ~6m.
bob-mlinfra: confirmed, prometheus scraping delays. prom-adapter logs show 503s to /metrics from metrics-server. suspect metrics adapter -> hpa pipeline backlog.
dylan-support: customer reports: increased latency and 429s from hosted endpoint rtx-gen-10. frank-customer: our app saw a 10x request latency increase and some requests dropped. urgent.
eva-product: which customers affected? any high-traffic trial accounts? need to notify CSMs.
alice-sre: top affected tenants: internal load-test, two enterprise tenants in us-west. severity: P1 for customer impact.
carla-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) disable new low-priority batch jobs hitting infer-gpu-prod 2) route new requests to us-east fallback 3) temporarily raise HPA maxReplicas while we fix metrics.
bob-mlinfra: can bump HPA max to 60 from 30 now but HPA won't scale without metrics. manual kubectl scale on deployment/gpu-infer-svc --replicas=40 would add capacity. want me to do it?
carla-oncall: go ahead manual scale, annotate with "incident/1713456789". Also request node-pool autoscaler increase (np-infer-2) by +4 nodes.
bob-mlinfra: running:```bash
kubectl scale deploy/gpu-infer-svc -n prod --replicas=40
kubectl annotate deploy/gpu-infer-svc incident/1713456789="manual-scale"
```
prometheus-bot: Alert resolved: Instance scrape failure recovered for prometheus/adapters (was 503). backlog still ~4500 samples.
alice-sre: after scale we drained queue by ~60% but new requests still throttled by quota layer. increased rate-limit for enterprise tier temporarily.
dylan-support: posting to status page: short blip on inference endpoints in us-west; working on mitigation.
eva-product: please draft customer message for impacted accounts, mention mitigation and ETA.
bob-mlinfra: root cause so far: metrics-server -> prometheus adapter had intermittent 503s due to a memory leak in prom-adapter v0.7.2; when it dropped it stopped updating custom metrics used by HPA. replication/autoscale logic fell back to CPU metrics which are low; HPA stayed flat.
carla-oncall: action items: (1) roll prom-adapter to 0.7.3 hotfix with patched client timeout (bob) (2) add short-term scrape retries and queue backfill (alice) (3) validate HPA behavior once metrics resume (carla) (4) follow-up postmortem owner (alice).
bob-mlinfra: rolling hotfix:```yaml
# prom-adapter hotfix rollout
image: prom-adapter:0.7.3-hotfix
resources:
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi
```
bob-mlinfra: applied rollout to us-west, watch pods status.
alice-sre: starting backfill job to replay missing metrics window into custom metrics API. will throttle the backfill to avoid overloading HPA.
carla-oncall: 14:21 UTC — handoff to alice-sre for remediation and postmortem. I'm going to stand down from active command but will stay in thread for customer comms.
alice-sre: confirming hotfix pod readiness, prom-adapter pods 3/3 ready. scraper latencies back to normal. custom/gpu_queue_length now ~5-10s lag. HPA events starting to appear.
prometheus-bot: Metric backlog processed: 4.2k -> 0 samples in 3m.
alice-sre: HPA reacted, scaled from 40 -> 18 -> target 28 over 6m. queue decreased and latency recovered to normal for most tenants.
frank-customer: confirming our service latency is back to baseline, thanks for the fast turnaround.
dylan-support: status update posted: incident mitigated, autoscaling restored, manual scale undone gradually.
eva-product: prepare short incident note for ops newsletter and notify CSMs for customers with elevated SLAs.
carla-oncall: final note for handoff: incident started 2024-04-08T14:13:09Z, mitigations: manual scale + node-pool bump + prom-adapter hotfix + backfill, customer impact: increased latency and some 429s for ~8-12m for a subset of us-west tenants, root cause: prom-adapter memory leak leading to custom metrics pipeline breakage -> delayed HPA. follow-up: full postmortem and permanent fix to prom-adapter, add scraping circuit-breakers, implement HPA fallback to queued request metrics if adapter fails. owner: alice-sre.
alice-sre: taking PM for postmortem, will include timeline, telemetry, and action items.
carla-oncall: closing page to on-call rotation. If anything regresses ping here and re-page. :white_check_mark:
